options.name: Action : Aetheric Strike
options.description: You channel raw magical energy through your palm, making a melee attack at adjacent range using your mysticism or arcane magic skill. For each dice that hits, deal 3 aetheric damage. This attack requires your hand to be completely uncovered and free.

options.name: Aetheric Resilience
options.description: Your body has adapted to the flow of magical energy. Gain +1 skill with endurance. Your aetheric mitigation limit is reduced by 3.

options.name: Aetheric Conditioning
options.description: Constant exposure to channeled energy has hardened your mind. Gain +1 skill with resilience and +2 aetheric mitigation.

options.name: Mystical Tuning
options.description: When you deal damage with an Aetheric Strike action during your turn, gain +5 mitigation to that damage type until the start of your next turn. This effect can only occur once per round.

options.name: Action : Ranged Aetheric Strike
options.description: You project magical energy at a target within a short (10 unit) range using your mysticism or arcane magic skill. For each dice that hits, deal 3 aetheric damage. This attack requires your hand to be completely uncovered and free.

options.name: Reaction : Mystical Deflection
options.description: In response to being targeted with a ranged attack, you can make a block check without the normal ranged penalties. If you successfully block the attack, the energy spent is refunded.

options.name: Cross Discipline
options.description: Your Aetheric Strike actions deal 4 damage per dice instead of 3. Additionally, gain +1 skill with deflection.

options.name: Elemental Channeling
options.description: Gain +1 skill with primal magic. You can use primal magic instead of mysticism or arcane for Aetheric Strike actions and change the damage type to heat, cold, or electric.

options.name: Arcane Attunement
options.description: Gain +1 skill with mysticism magic and +1 skill with arcane magic.

options.name: Daily Action : Avatar State
options.description: You enter a state of pure channeling. For the next minute, roll a bonus dice on all Aetheric Strike attacks while you maintain concentration.
